# Swimming World Magazine

> Leading source for competitive swimming news, NCAA coverage, and training resources serving swimmers and enthusiasts worldwide.

Swimming World Magazine provides comprehensive coverage of NCAA Division I swimming, international competitions, and athlete profiles. The site offers news aggregation, training tools, and subscription access to digital swimming content.

## Key Topics

- NCAA Division I
- Competitive Swimming
- World Records
- College Swimming
- Swimming News
- NCAA Championships
- Women's Championships
- Relay Racing
- International Swimming
- Commonwealth Games
- Pan Pacific Championships
- Digital Magazine Subscription
- Swimming Workouts
- World Anti-Doping Agency
- Olympic Swimming

## News & Coverage

- [Swimming News | Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com): Homepage featuring latest NCAA and international swimming news
- [Recent Swimming News - All Categories](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news): Aggregated swimming news from athletes like Haughey and O'Callaghan
- [Swimming News | Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/news-categories): Categorized swimming news covering NCAA and international competitions

## Subscription & Access

- [Subscribe to Swimming World](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/join): Subscription page for Swimming World magazine and digital access products

## Tools & Resources

- [Swim Time Conversion | Short Course Yards to Long Course Meters Time Converter](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/time-conversion): Tool converting swim times between SCY and LCM standards
- [Swimming World - Workouts](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/swim-cgi): Searchable workout database for swimmers of all ability levels

## Events & Results

- [All Covered Meets & Events](https://www.swimmingworldmagazine.com/meets): Directory of NCAA and Olympic swimming meets with results archive
